fact_text: The analyst said the market trades at about 6.8 times forward 2027 earnings, against a historical average of about 7 times, so the market is already near its fair multiple.

fact_text: The historical average forward multiple for the market was cited as about 7 times, the benchmark against which the analyst judged the market to be fairly valued.

fact_text: The 25 to 27 percent return projection combines a P/E re-rating component, the index dividend yield and earnings growth, with blanket gains across all stocks not expected.

fact_text: Privatising Pakistan International Airlines was named as a second trigger, since the state has been covering PIA's losses and staff salaries, so a completed sale would free fiscal space and lift sentiment.

fact_text: Long-term concessions or privatisation of power distribution companies (DISCOs) were expected to follow the PIA sale and form part of the IMF programme, which the analyst treated as a further trigger.

fact_text: Listed companies holding mining leases were reportedly waiting for the Reko Diq financial close before approaching major global miners, so the close was treated as a sector-wide trigger.

fact_text: The Reko Diq financial close was already delayed by about seven to eight months; the earlier timeline was June-July, and the new expectation was end-December or early January for completion of financial close.

fact_text: The delay was attributed to a management change at Barrick Gold and a US government shutdown that held up EXIM Bank, whose contribution to the project was put at about 900 million dollars.

fact_text: The analyst said the company remained confident the latest delay would not change the project completion timeline, because construction work was continuing in parallel with financing.

fact_text: The analyst called resolution of the gas-sector circular debt a game changer for E&P companies, since it would let the sector recover receivables that the government owes.

fact_text: PPL's pending receivables were said to be over Rs 200 per share, roughly equal to its market capitalisation, with the government considering late payment charges on the dues.

fact_text: The analyst thought the receivables were recoverable, and if PPL is paid, its cash flow value would improve significantly, which is why the gas-sector payment issue matters.

fact_text: PPL shares were trading at about Rs 200, close to the value of the pending receivables per share, according to the analyst.

fact_text: E&P profitability in the March and June quarters of FY26 could be relatively better than the two previous quarters, unless a major exploration drive occurs.

fact_text: Local natural gas output was about 2,900 to 3,000 mmcfd, while total gas supply was about 3,900 to 4,000 mmcfd, according to the analyst's figures.

fact_text: Deferring two or three RLNG cargoes would cut supply by about 200 to 300 mmcfd, which the analyst expected to move local E&P gas volumes back toward 3,100 to 3,200 mmcfd from about 2,900.

fact_text: The analyst said peak local gas volumes would not be fully affected, because about six or seven RLNG cargoes would still be imported, so the effect on E&P volumes would be gradual.

fact_text: A government electricity subsidy was expected to raise utilisation of RLNG-based power plants, lifting gas demand and supporting E&P volumes once the package is approved and executed.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: The firm was overweight on quality cement companies and expected the cement sector to outperform in 2026, supported by pricing discipline and profitability gains.

fact_text: Indus Motor was described as a good stock, with volumetric growth above 50 percent already visible, according to the analyst.

source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: Pakistan's trade with India was reported to have been suspended since 2019, with borders closed, and the analyst expected bilateral relations to remain at an all-time low.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: Terrorist activity was said to disrupt oil and gas fields and cause large production losses, a concern given that the largest onshore potential lies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and parts of Balochistan.

fact_text: Pakistan's tax-to-GDP target requires an increase of 300 basis points, so broad tax cuts were not seen as possible, though limited relief was seen as achievable.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: The primary surplus target limits fiscal room, so the analyst saw PIA and DISCO privatisation and an NFC change as the main realistic sources of relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst did not expect a significant policy rate cut while the IMF programme is in place, since the government was not seen to be in a position to cut rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: IMF statements on cash management and fiscal discipline were reported to worry some investors, and the analyst said that concern was valid.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)

fact_text: The analyst said returns for the broader market in 2026 would be limited and highly selective, in the 25 to 30 percent range, rather than the very large gains seen earlier.

fact_text: The analyst said the market is less attractive than it was earlier, so blanket gains across stocks are not available and a selective stock choice is needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, '2026 Investment Outlook: PSX Triggers And Risks Explained | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-28)
